transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, thank you.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Are you a teacher?

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Yes, I think that that’s a very good question, because I’ve heard from lots of teachers and parents about some of their concerns about some of the things that are being said and done in this campaign.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I think it is very important for us to make clear to our children that our country really is great because we’re good.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And we are going to respect one another, lift each other up.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We are going to be looking for ways to celebrate our diversity, and we are going to try to reach out to every boy and girl, as well as every adult, to bring them in to working on behalf of our country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I have a very positive and optimistic view about what we can do together.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: That’s why the slogan of my campaign is “Stronger Together,” because I think if we work together, if we overcome the divisiveness that sometimes sets Americans against one another, and instead we make some big goals—and I’ve set forth some big goals, getting the economy to work for everyone, not just those at the top, making sure that we have the best education system from preschool through college and making it affordable, and so much else.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: If we set those goals and we go together to try to achieve them, there’s nothing in my opinion that America can’t do.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So that’s why I hope that we will come together in this campaign.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Obviously, I’m hoping to earn your vote, I’m hoping to be elected in November, and I can promise you, I will work with every American.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I want to be the president for all Americans, regardless of your political beliefs, where you come from, what you look like, your religion.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I want us to heal our country and bring it together because that’s, I think, the best way for us to get the future that our children and our grandchildren deserve.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Well, I actually agree with that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I agree with everything she said.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I began this campaign because I was so tired of seeing such foolish things happen to our country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: This is a great country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: This is a great land.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’ve gotten to know the people of the country over the last year-and-a-half that I’ve been doing this as a politician.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I cannot believe I’m saying that about myself, but I guess I have been a politician.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And my whole concept was to make America great again.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: When I watch the deals being made, when I watch what’s happening with some horrible things like Obamacare, where your health insurance and health care is going up by numbers that are astronomical, 68 percent, 59 percent, 71 percent, when I look at the Iran deal and how bad a deal it is for us, it’s a one-sided transaction where we’re giving back $150 billion to a terrorist state, really, the number one terror state, we’ve made them a strong country from really a very weak country just three years ago.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: When I look at all of the things that I see and all of the potential that our country has, we have such tremendous potential, whether it’s in business and trade, where we’re doing so badly.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Last year, we had an almost $800 billion trade deficit.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: In other words, trading with other countries.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We had an $800 billion deficit.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s hard to believe.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Inconceivable.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You say who’s making these deals?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to make great trade deals.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to have a strong border.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to bring back law and order.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Just today, policemen was shot, two killed.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And this is happening on a weekly basis.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have to bring back respect to law enforcement.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: At the same time, we have to take care of people on all sides.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We need justice.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But I want to do things that haven’t been done, including fixing and making our inner cities better for the African-American citizens that are so great, and for the Latinos, Hispanics, and I look forward to doing it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s called make America great again.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: No, I didn’t say that at all.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I don’t think you understood what was—this was locker room talk.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m not proud of it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I apologize to my family.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I apologize to the American people.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Certainly, I’m not proud of it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But this is locker room talk.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You know, when we have a world where you have ISIS chopping off heads, where you have—and, frankly, drowning people in steel cages, where you have wars and horrible, horrible sights all over, where you have so many bad things happening, this is like medieval times.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We haven’t seen anything like this, the carnage all over the world.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And they look and they see.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Can you imagine the people that are, frankly, doing so well against us with ISIS?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And they look at our country and they see what’s going on.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Yes, I’m very embarrassed by it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I hate it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But it’s locker room talk, and it’s one of those things.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I will knock the hell out of ISIS.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to defeat ISIS.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: ISIS happened a number of years ago in a vacuum that was left because of bad judgment.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I will tell you, I will take care of ISIS.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And we should get on to much more important things and much bigger things.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I have great respect for women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Nobody has more respect for women than I do.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’ve said things that, frankly, you hear these things I said.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I was embarrassed by it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But I have tremendous respect for women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And women have respect for me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I will tell you: No, I have not.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I will tell you that I’m going to make our country safe.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to have borders in our country, which we don’t have now.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: People are pouring into our country, and they’re coming in from the Middle East and other places.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to make America safe again.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re going to make America great again, but we’re going to make America safe again.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And we’re going to make America wealthy again, because if you don’t do that, it just—it sounds harsh to say, but we have to build up the wealth of our nation.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Right now, other nations are taking our jobs and they’re taking our wealth.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And that’s what I want to talk about.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, like everyone else, I’ve spent a lot of time thinking over the last 48 hours about what we heard and saw.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: You know, with prior Republican nominees for president, I disagreed with them on politics, policies, principles, but I never questioned their fitness to serve.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Donald Trump is different.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I said starting back in June that he was not fit to be president and commander-in-chief.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And many Republicans and independents have said the same thing.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: What we all saw and heard on Friday was Donald talking about women, what he thinks about women, what he does to women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And he has said that the video doesn’t represent who he is.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But I think it’s clear to anyone who heard it that it represents exactly who he is.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Because we’ve seen this throughout the campaign.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We have seen him insult women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We’ve seen him rate women on their appearance, ranking them from one to ten.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We’ve seen him embarrass women on TV and on Twitter.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We saw him after the first debate spend nearly a week denigrating a former Miss Universe in the harshest, most personal terms.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So, yes, this is who Donald Trump is.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But it’s not only women, and it’s not only this video that raises questions about his fitness to be our president, because he has also targeted immigrants, African-Americans, Latinos, people with disabilities, POWs, Muslims, and so many others.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So this is who Donald Trump is.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And the question for us, the question our country must answer is that this is not who we are.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: That’s why—to go back to your question—I want to send a message—we all should—to every boy and girl and, indeed, to the entire world that America already is great, but we are great because we are good, and we will respect one another, and we will work with one another, and we will celebrate our diversity.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: These are very important values to me, because this is the America that I know and love.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I can pledge to you tonight that this is the America that I will serve if I’m so fortunate enough to become your president.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Am I allowed to respond to that?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I assume I am.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s just words, folks.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s just words.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Those words, I’ve been hearing them for many years.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I heard them when they were running for the Senate in New York, where Hillary was going to bring back jobs to upstate New York and she failed.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’ve heard them where Hillary is constantly talking about the inner cities of our country, which are a disaster education-wise, job-wise, safety-wise, in every way possible.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m going to help the African-Americans.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m going to help the Latinos, Hispanics.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I am going to help the inner cities.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She’s done a terrible job for the African-Americans.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She wants their vote, and she does nothing, and then she comes back four years later.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We saw that firsthand when she was a United States senator.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She campaigned where the primary part of her campaign…

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So, she’s allowed to do that, but I’m not allowed to respond?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Sounds fair.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It was locker room talk, as I told you.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: That was locker room talk.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m not proud of it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I am a person who has great respect for people, for my family, for the people of this country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And certainly, I’m not proud of it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But that was something that happened.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: If you look at Bill Clinton, far worse.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Mine are words, and his was action.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: His was what he’s done to women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: There’s never been anybody in the history of politics in this nation that’s been so abusive to women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So you can say any way you want to say it, but Bill Clinton was abusive to women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Hillary Clinton attacked those same women and attacked them viciously.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Four of them here tonight.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: One of the women, who is a wonderful woman, at 12 years old, was raped at 12.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Her client she represented got him off, and she’s seen laughing on two separate occasions, laughing at the girl who was raped.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Kathy Shelton, that young woman is here with us tonight.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So don’t tell me about words.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I am absolutely—I apologize for those words.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But it is things that people say.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But what President Clinton did, he was impeached, he lost his license to practice law.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: He had to pay an $850,000 fine to one of the women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Paula Jones, who’s also here tonight.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I will tell you that when Hillary brings up a point like that and she talks about words that I said 11 years ago, I think it’s disgraceful, and I think she should be ashamed of herself, if you want to know the truth.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, first, let me start by saying that so much of what he’s just said is not right, but he gets to run his campaign any way he chooses.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He gets to decide what he wants to talk about.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Instead of answering people’s questions, talking about our agenda, laying out the plans that we have that we think can make a better life and a better country, that’s his choice.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: When I hear something like that, I am reminded of what my friend, Michelle Obama, advised us all: When they go low, you go high.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And, look, if this were just about one video, maybe what he’s saying tonight would be understandable, but everyone can draw their own conclusions at this point about whether or not the man in the video or the man on the stage respects women.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But he never apologizes for anything to anyone.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He never apologized to Mr.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: and Mrs.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Khan, the Gold Star family whose son, Captain Khan, died in the line of duty in Iraq.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And Donald insulted and attacked them for weeks over their religion.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He never apologized to the distinguished federal judge who was born in Indiana, but Donald said he couldn’t be trusted to be a judge because his parents were, quote, “Mexican.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: ” He never apologized to the reporter that he mimicked and mocked on national television and our children were watching.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And he never apologized for the racist lie that President Obama was not born in the United States of America.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He owes the president an apology, he owes our country an apology, and he needs to take responsibility for his actions and his words.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Well, you owe the president an apology, because as you know very well, your campaign, Sidney Blumenthal—he’s another real winner that you have—and he’s the one that got this started, along with your campaign manager, and they were on television just two weeks ago, she was, saying exactly that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So you really owe him an apology.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You’re the one that sent the pictures around your campaign, sent the pictures around with President Obama in a certain garb.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: That was long before I was ever involved, so you actually owe an apology.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Number two, Michelle Obama.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’ve gotten to see the commercials that they did on you.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I’ve gotten to see some of the most vicious commercials I’ve ever seen of Michelle Obama talking about you, Hillary.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So, you talk about friend?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Go back and take a look at those commercials, a race where you lost fair and square, unlike the Bernie Sanders race, where you won, but not fair and square, in my opinion.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And all you have to do is take a look at WikiLeaks and just see what they said about Bernie Sanders and see what Deborah Wasserman Schultz had in mind, because Bernie Sanders, between super-delegates and Deborah Wasserman Schultz, he never had a chance.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I was so surprised to see him sign on with the devil.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But when you talk about apology, I think the one that you should really be apologizing for and the thing that you should be apologizing for are the 33,000 e-mails that you deleted, and that you acid washed, and then the two boxes of e-mails and other things last week that were taken from an office and are now missing.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I’ll tell you what.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I didn’t think I’d say this, but I’m going to say it, and I hate to say it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But if I win, I am going to instruct my attorney general to get a special prosecutor to look into your situation, because there has never been so many lies, so much deception.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: There has never been anything like it, and we’re going to have a special prosecutor.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: When I speak, I go out and speak, the people of this country are furious.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: In my opinion, the people that have been long-term workers at the FBI are furious.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: There has never been anything like this, where e-mails—and you get a subpoena, you get a subpoena, and after getting the subpoena, you delete 33,000 e-mails, and then you acid wash them or bleach them, as you would say, very expensive process.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So we’re going to get a special prosecutor, and we’re going to look into it, because you know what?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: People have been—their lives have been destroyed for doing one-fifth of what you’ve done.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And it’s a disgrace.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And honestly, you ought to be ashamed of yourself.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: … because everything he just said is absolutely false, but I’m not surprised.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Oh, really?

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: In the first debate…

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: … I told people that it would be impossible to be fact-checking Donald all the time.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I’d never get to talk about anything I want to do and how we’re going to really make lives better for people.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So, once again, go to HillaryClinton.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We have literally Trump—you can fact check him in real time.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Last time at the first debate, we had millions of people fact checking, so I expect we’ll have millions more fact checking, because, you know, it is—it’s just awfully good that someone with the temperament of Donald Trump is not in charge of the law in our country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Because you’d be in jail.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, Martha, first, let me say—and I’ve said before, but I’ll repeat it, because I want everyone to hear it—that was a mistake, and I take responsibility for using a personal e-mail account.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Obviously, if I were to do it over again, I would not.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I’m not making any excuses.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: It was a mistake.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I am very sorry about that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But I think it’s also important to point out where there are some misleading accusations from critics and others.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: After a year-long investigation, there is no evidence that anyone hacked the server I was using and there is no evidence that anyone can point to at all—anyone who says otherwise has no basis—that any classified material ended up in the wrong hands.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I take classified materials very seriously and always have.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: When I was on the Senate Armed Services Committee, I was privy to a lot of classified material.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Obviously, as secretary of state, I had some of the most important secrets that we possess, such as going after Bin Laden.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So I am very committed to taking classified information seriously.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And as I said, there is no evidence that any classified information ended up in the wrong hands.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And yet she didn’t know the word—the letter C on a document.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Right?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She didn’t even know what that word—what that letter meant.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You know, it’s amazing.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m watching Hillary go over facts.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And she’s going after fact after fact, and she’s lying again, because she said she—you know, what she did with the e-mails was fine.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You think it was fine to delete 33,000 e-mails?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I don’t think so.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She said the 33,000 e-mails had to do with her daughter’s wedding, number one, and a yoga class.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Well, maybe we’ll give three or three or four or five or something.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: 33,000 e-mails deleted, and now she’s saying there wasn’t anything wrong.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And more importantly, that was after getting a subpoena.

transcript_turns.text: I have, between Facebook and Twitter, I have almost 25 million people.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s a very effective way of communication.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So you can put it down, but it is a very effective form of communication.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m not un-proud of it, to be honest with you.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: No.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m shocked to hear that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, it’s not only my opinion.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: It’s the opinion of many others, national security experts, Republicans, former Republican members of Congress.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But it’s in part because those of us who have had the great privilege of seeing this job up close and know how difficult it is, and it’s not just because I watched my husband take a $300 billion deficit and turn it into a $200 billion surplus, and 23 million new jobs were created, and incomes went up for everybody.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Everybody.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: African-American incomes went up 33 percent.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And it’s not just because I worked with George W.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Bush after 9/11, and I was very proud that when I told him what the city needed, what we needed to recover, he said you’ve got it, and he never wavered.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He stuck with me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I have worked and I admire President Obama.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He inherited the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: That was a terrible time for our country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Nine million people lost their jobs.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Five million homes were lost.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And $13 trillion in family wealth was wiped out.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We are back on the right track.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: He would send us back into recession with his tax plans that benefit the wealthiest of Americans.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have the slowest growth since 1929.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It is—our country has the slowest growth and jobs are a disaster.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Thank you.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, you’re right.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: This is one of the most important issues in this election.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I want to appoint Supreme Court justices who understand the way the world really works, who have real-life experience, who have not just been in a big law firm and maybe clerked for a judge and then gotten on the bench, but, you know, maybe they tried some more cases, they actually understand what people are up against.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Because I think the current court has gone in the wrong direction.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And so I would want to see the Supreme Court reverse Citizens United and get dark, unaccountable money out of our politics.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Donald doesn’t agree with that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I would like the Supreme Court to understand that voting rights are still a big problem in many parts of our country, that we don’t always do everything we can to make it possible for people of color and older people and young people to be able to exercise their franchise.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I want a Supreme Court that will stick with Roe v.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Wade and a woman’s right to choose, and I want a Supreme Court that will stick with marriage equality.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Now, Donald has put forth the names of some people that he would consider.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And among the ones that he has suggested are people who would reverse Roe v.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Wade and reverse marriage equality.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I think that would be a terrible mistake and would take us backwards.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I want a Supreme Court that doesn’t always side with corporate interests.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I want a Supreme Court that understands because you’re wealthy and you can give more money to something doesn’t mean you have any more rights or should have any more rights than anybody else.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So I have very clear views about what I want to see to kind of change the balance on the Supreme Court.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I regret deeply that the Senate has not done its job and they have not permitted a vote on the person that President Obama, a highly qualified person, they’ve not given him a vote to be able to be have the full complement of nine Supreme Court justices.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I think that was a dereliction of duty.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I hope that they will see their way to doing it, but if I am so fortunate enough as to be president, I will immediately move to make sure that we fill that, we have nine justices that get to work on behalf of our people.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Justice Scalia, great judge, died recently.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And we have a vacancy.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I am looking to appoint judges very much in the mold of Justice Scalia.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m looking for judges—and I’ve actually picked 20 of them so that people would see, highly respected, highly thought of, and actually very beautifully reviewed by just about everybody.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But people that will respect the Constitution of the United States.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I think that this is so important.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Also, the Second Amendment, which is totally under siege by people like Hillary Clinton.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They’ll respect the Second Amendment and what it stands for, what it represents.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So important to me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Now, Hillary mentioned something about contributions just so you understand.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So I will have in my race more than $100 million put in—of my money, meaning I’m not taking all of this big money from all of these different corporations like she’s doing.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: What I ask is this.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So I’m putting in more than—by the time it’s finished, I’ll have more than $100 million invested.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Pretty much self-funding mine.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We’re raising money for the Republican Party, and we’re doing tremendously on the small donations, $61 average or so.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I ask Hillary, why doesn’t—she made $250 million by being in office.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She used the power of her office to make a lot of money.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Why isn’t she funding, not for $100 million, but why don’t you put $10 million or $20 million or $25 million or $30 million into your own campaign?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s $30 million less for special interests that will tell you exactly what to do and it would really, I think, be a nice sign to the American public.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Why aren’t you putting some money in?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You have a lot of it.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You’ve made a lot of it because of the fact that you’ve been in office.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Made a lot of it while you were secretary of state, actually.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So why aren’t you putting money into your own campaign?

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I’m just curious.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well…

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: The question was about the Supreme Court.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I just want to quickly say, I respect the Second Amendment.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But I believe there should be comprehensive background checks, and we should close the gun show loophole, and close the online loophole.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We have to save as many lives as we possibly can.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Absolutely.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I think it’s such a great question, because energy is under siege by the Obama administration.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Under absolutely siege.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: The EPA, Environmental Protection Agency, is killing these energy companies.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And foreign companies are now coming in buying our—buying so many of our different plants and then re-jiggering the plant so that they can take care of their oil.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We are killing—absolutely killing our energy business in this country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Now, I’m all for alternative forms of energy, including wind, including solar, et cetera.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But we need much more than wind and solar.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And you look at our miners.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Hillary Clinton wants to put all the miners out of business.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: There is a thing called clean coal.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Coal will last for 1,000 years in this country.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Now we have natural gas and so many other things because of technology.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have unbelievable—we have found over the last seven years, we have found tremendous wealth right under our feet.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So good.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Especially when you have $20 trillion in debt.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I will bring our energy companies back.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They’ll be able to compete.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They’ll make money.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They’ll pay off our national debt.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: They’ll pay off our tremendous budget deficits, which are tremendous.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But we are putting our energy companies out of business.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have to bring back our workers.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: You take a look at what’s happening to steel and the cost of steel and China dumping vast amounts of steel all over the United States, which essentially is killing our steelworkers and our steel companies.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have to guard our energy companies.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: We have to make it possible.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: The EPA is so restrictive that they are putting our energy companies out of business.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And all you have to do is go to a great place like West Virginia or places like Ohio, which is phenomenal, or places like Pennsylvania and you see what they’re doing to the people, miners and others in the energy business.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s a disgrace.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: It’s an absolute disgrace.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And actually—well, that was very interesting.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: First of all, China is illegally dumping steel in the United States and Donald Trump is buying it to build his buildings, putting steelworkers and American steel plants out of business.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: That’s something that I fought against as a senator and that I would have a trade prosecutor to make sure that we don’t get taken advantage of by China on steel or anything else.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: You know, because it sounds like you’re in the business or you’re aware of people in the business—you know that we are now for the first time ever energy-independent.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We are not dependent upon the Middle East.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But the Middle East still controls a lot of the prices.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So the price of oil has been way down.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And that has had a damaging effect on a lot of the oil companies, right?

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We are, however, producing a lot of natural gas, which serves as a bridge to more renewable fuels.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I think that’s an important transition.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We’ve got to remain energy-independent.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: It gives us much more power and freedom than to be worried about what goes on in the Middle East.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We have enough worries over there without having to worry about that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So I have a comprehensive energy policy, but it really does include fighting climate change, because I think that is a serious problem.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I support moving toward more clean, renewable energy as quickly as we can, because I think we can be the 21st century clean energy superpower and create millions of new jobs and businesses.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But I also want to be sure that we don’t leave people behind.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: That’s why I’m the only candidate from the very beginning of this campaign who had a plan to help us revitalize coal country, because those coal miners and their fathers and their grandfathers, they dug that coal out.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: A lot of them lost their lives.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: They were injured, but they turned the lights on and they powered our factories.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I don’t want to walk away from them.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So we’ve got to do something for them.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: But the price of coal is down worldwide.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So we have to look at this comprehensively.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And that’s exactly what I have proposed.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I hope you will go to HillaryClinton.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: com and look at my entire policy.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Well, I certainly will, because I think that’s a very fair and important question.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: Look, I respect his children.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: His children are incredibly able and devoted, and I think that says a lot about Donald.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: I don’t agree with nearly anything else he says or does, but I do respect that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I think that is something that as a mother and a grandmother is very important to me.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: So I believe that this election has become in part so—so conflict-oriented, so intense because there’s a lot at stake.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: This is not an ordinary time, and this is not an ordinary election.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: We are going to be choosing a president who will set policy for not just four or eight years, but because of some of the important decisions we have to make here at home and around the world, from the Supreme Court to energy and so much else, and so there is a lot at stake.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: It’s one of the most consequential elections that we’ve had.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And that’s why I’ve tried to put forth specific policies and plans, trying to get it off of the personal and put it on to what it is I want to do as president.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And that’s why I hope people will check on that for themselves so that they can see that, yes, I’ve spent 30 years, actually maybe a little more, working to help kids and families.

transcript_turns.speaker: Hillary Clinton
transcript_turns.text: And I want to take all that experience to the White House and do that every single day.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: Well, I consider her statement about my children to be a very nice compliment.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I don’t know if it was meant to be a compliment, but it is a great—I’m very proud of my children.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And they’ve done a wonderful job, and they’ve been wonderful, wonderful kids.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: So I consider that a compliment.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I will say this about Hillary.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She doesn’t quit.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She doesn’t give up.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I respect that.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I tell it like it is.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: She’s a fighter.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I disagree with much of what she’s fighting for.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: I do disagree with her judgment in many cases.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: But she does fight hard, and she doesn’t quit, and she doesn’t give up.

transcript_turns.speaker: Donald Trump
transcript_turns.text: And I consider that to be a very good trait.
